targets.review_note: Octal groups exactly three binary digits per digit. Left-pad the integer part and right-pad the fractional part to complete groups, then remove only insignificant leading integer zeroes. Translate octal digits 1..7 to A..G as demonstrated by the examples; zero digits and the radix point become spaces in the alphabetic representation. Work with digit groups rather than floating-point values so long binary fractions remain exact.
